claim: If and only if the frozen readiness record is HARNESS_READY and its lock verifies, the WP4 upstairs control gauntlet accepts the declared known integrals and rejects the declared false and functionally dependent controls on the qualified WP2-UPQ-v2 one-channel canonical model, after verifying the authoritative WP3-UP-CAND-v3 bounded-null chain.
evidence_boundary: This qualification covers deterministic numerical differentiation, canonical Poisson behavior, local functional-rank discrimination, S1 gauge behavior, and bounded fictitious-time integration for known controls on six declared collision-free zero-Xi states. It is a runtime-bound harness readiness result, not validation of an additional first integral. Because WP3-UP-CAND-v3 produced no training-eligible candidate subspace, candidate-specific sealed qualification and Morales-Ramis analysis are not triggered. It excludes sealed-reserve execution, Liouville integrability, non-integrability, collision passage, other KS channels, and global three-body regularization.

staged_policy.HARNESS_READY: All frozen control gates pass against exact WP2-UPQ-v2 and the authoritative WP3-UP-CAND-v3 bounded-null chain on the runtime captured by the lock.
staged_policy.CANDIDATE_NOT_TRIGGERED: Mandatory when the verified WP3-v3 spectral certificate excludes every training-eligible direction and the candidate decision reports zero candidate subspaces.
staged_policy.MORALES_RAMIS_NOT_TRIGGERED: Mandatory because no candidate-specific sealed qualification was triggered.
